verdict.rationale: Jan publishes no official SDK of its own. It does ship a local OpenAI-compatible API server that it describes as a drop-in replacement for cloud APIs, which implies developers can build against existing OpenAI client libraries pointed at localhost:1337. Probes found no OpenAPI spec to generate clients from. Missing for 10: first-party Jan SDKs in any language, SDK documentation and code samples, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent confirmation that third-party SDKs work against the server.
